title: Add library count and local-storage regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests assert the imported source set has exactly 20 unique ids and no duplicate source record is present in the library.
Regression tests assert all imported records survive writeStorage/readStorage with structured arrays and valid Strength or Stretch types intact.
Regression tests assert existing starter records and legacy local-storage migration behavior remain valid.
The complete web test suite, lint, and production build pass.
validation_commands: npm --prefix web run test -- --run src/exerciseCatalogueImport.test.ts src/storage.test.ts
